title: 金翅雀特许经营权所有者权威指南
instruction:
您是 Goldfinch Systems 的药剂师合规主管。在一名特许经营店主在药房库存订单上使用了他们无权签署的签名后，Linnea Rutkowski 希望在 1 月份会议之前向所有 30 名店主提供一份指南。大多数店主都是杂货商，而不是药剂师，商店分布在明尼苏达州和北达科他州。所有者希望运营可见性，而 PIC 将所有者头衔视为完全授权或根本没有授权。 Estelle Marchetti 还需要您就是否应默认启用订购和患者信息访问还是仅在角色批准后启用提出建议。涵盖截至 10 月1、2025 的法律，并与 1 月1、2024 进行简要比较。明确哪些要求是强制性的，哪些是金翅雀的保障措施；业主还必须知道当由于没有权限或凭证而无法完成紧急订单时会发生什么。制作不超过四页的`franchise_owner_authority_guide.pdf`、`state_authority_matrix.xlsx`和一页`authority_exception_card.docx`。排除患者示例和系统点击。使用这些文件名将所有三个文件写入工作目录的顶层，并使它们可以一起使用而无需后续调用。

---
将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：

- `franchise_owner_authority_guide.pdf` — 简明语言的特许经营权所有者指南，涵盖签名、订购、信息访问、状态差异、随时间的变化以及推荐的权限模型。 （不超过四个渲染页面；当前到十月1、2025；将适用位置与一月1、2024进行比较；不包括患者示例和软件点击说明。）
- `state_authority_matrix.xlsx` — 可用的各州权威矩阵，支持所有者、PIC、受控物质订购、许可和信息访问决策。 （必须作为操作矩阵可读，并与指南和例外卡保持一致。）
- `authority_exception_card.docx` — 针对无法确认权限、凭证或允许访问的情况提供一页的一线决策帮助。 （恰好一个渲染页面或更少；必须提供安全的停止和升级路径，无需软件点击说明或患者示例。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

gold.text:
GOLDFINCH SYSTEMS
Authority Exception Card
Frontline stop • verify • escalate • release | Minnesota + North Dakota | current through 10/01/2025
DEFAULT: Owner ordering authority and patient-level PHI access stay OFF unless role-approved and current authority is confirmed. This is a Goldfinch safeguard; legal requirements below always apply.

STOP NOW
Do not sign another person’s name, use a copied signature, or lend/use another person’s CSOS certificate or credentials. Do not proceed on unverified ownership/permit authority. Do not view or disclose PHI without a verified role, purpose, and minimum-necessary basis. Urgency, a deadline, loss, or owner instruction does not bypass these rules.

Situation
1. Stop & verify
2. Route
3. Release only when
Schedule II order; Form 222; CSOS; POA; local DEA registration
Stop if signer, POA, certificate, registration, or status is expired, revoked, unavailable, or cannot be confirmed. Never recreate under another identity.
PIC / pharmacy operations; controlled-substance compliance.
A current local registrant-linked authority and personal credential are verified, or an approved lawful alternative is documented. Delay if needed.
Schedule III–V order or controlled shipment receipt
Stop if assigned purchaser scope is unknown or receipt/order records do not reconcile.
PIC / pharmacy operations; controlled-substance compliance for discrepancy.
Assigned authority is confirmed and pharmacy security, record, receipt, and reconciliation controls are satisfied.
MN/ND ownership, entity, control, permit, location, or PIC change
Stop signing/closing/implementation when the approved state structure or filing requirement is not verified. ND exceptions/grandfathering are never assumed transferable.
Pharmacy legal / regulatory affairs; Board process as directed.
Current state structure plus required notice, approval, or application status are verified before action.
PIC conflict or owner instruction about regulated practice
Stop the disputed regulated action. The owner cannot override professional judgment or require a violation, false record, or unauthorized signer.
PIC, pharmacy operations, compliance/legal as needed.
A lawful resolution preserves PIC accountability and pharmacist judgment.
Patient-level PHI request or uncertain purpose
Withhold access/disclosure. Ownership, curiosity, relationships, disputes, marketing, and general oversight are insufficient.
Privacy officer / information security review.
Documented workforce role, permitted purpose, minimum-necessary scope and access approval—or another valid disclosure basis—is confirmed.

Preserve, do not copy: requester, requested action, store, time, authority checked, credential/status, document or order identifier, and disposition. Do not copy passwords, private keys, CSOS credentials, signatures, or unnecessary PHI.
Required legal rule: Use only verified current authority.  Goldfinch safeguard: retain the concise exception record and revalidate changed roles or credentials promptly.

GOLDFINCH SYSTEMS | FRANCHISE AUTHORITY                                                                                                                  Operational guide • current through 01 Oct 2025




                                           Franchise Owner Authority Guide
  Minnesota + North Dakota retail pharmacies | Federal controlled-substance and HIPAA baseline | Current through 1 October
  2025

   DECISION: Default owner ordering authority and patient-level access to OFF. Enable only after role approval, current
   documentation, and the applicable regulated authority are confirmed. This is a Goldfinch safeguard; it does not replace legal
   requirements.


  The simple rule
  LAW — must: A franchise, corporate title, check-signing authority, or funding responsibility does not itself make someone the pharmacy license/permit
  holder, DEA registrant, pharmacist-in-charge (PIC), pharmacist, authorized controlled-substance signer, workforce member, or authorized PHI user.
  Urgency, a vendor deadline, inventory pressure, financial ownership, or an owner instruction cannot cure missing authority.
  Role                                       What it is — and is not

  Franchise owner / entity officer           Business authority only. May sign a truthful owner/applicant or entity submission if that form calls for it and the signer is authorized for the entity; may
                                             not sign a PIC, pharmacist, DEA-registrant, or authorized-purchaser attestation merely because of ownership.

  Licensed pharmacy / permit holder          The approved entity and location to which state licensure/permit attaches. A franchise relationship or another store’s permit is not the local license.

  DEA registrant                             The registered pharmacy location for controlled substances. Each location must have the applicable registration; another store’s registration is not
                                             portable.

  PIC / pharmacist                           PIC remains accountable for lawful practice, supervision, security, records, and operation. Delegation of a business task does not transfer
                                             professional judgment or regulatory accountability.

  Authorized purchaser / signer              A person with the specific authority required for that transaction; title is not enough. Controlled-substance authority is checked against the registrant,
                                             POA, and personal credential where applicable.

  Workforce member / business                A workforce member may use PHI only for an assigned permitted function and minimum necessary amount. A separate service provider is a business
  associate                                  associate only under the required relationship; a BAA is not permission to browse.


  Owner / PIC boundary
  LAW — must: An owner may not direct the PIC or another pharmacist to violate law, override professional judgment, falsify records, or use an
  unauthorized signer. The PIC is not the owner’s purchasing delegate. GOLDFINCH SAFEGUARD: document the assigned function, entity role, approver,
  scope, and end date before enabling any exception.




Internal compliance resource — not a substitute for regulator, counsel, or board review for a specific transaction.                                                                                  Page 1
 GOLDFINCH SYSTEMS | FRANCHISE AUTHORITY                                                                                                               Operational guide • current through 01 Oct 2025



  Controlled-substance ordering & receipt
  Never: sign another person’s name; use or lend another person’s CSOS certificate/credential; treat a copied signature as authorization; or recreate an
  order under an unavailable person’s identity. These are stop conditions.
  Transaction                     Legal boundary — must                                                                               Goldfinch operating control

  Schedule I–II order             DEA Form 222 applies to Schedule I or II orders. In retail practice, Schedule I is ordinarily not   Keep a current signer/POA roster by DEA-registered location;
                                  ordered; Schedule II ordering still requires the registrant or a person holding the registrant’s    independently verify before activation and revalidate
                                  valid DEA power of attorney (POA) before signing. An ordinary purchase-order signature is           periodically.
                                  insufficient.

  CSOS order                      CSOS is the electronic controlled-substance ordering method. It does not bypass                     Disable access promptly when employment, role,
                                  registration-linked authority or Form 222 concepts. The certificate is individual—not a shared      authorization, registration, certificate, or relevant status ends
                                  store credential—and must be current for the authorized signer.                                     or changes.

  Schedule III–V order            Form 222/CSOS is not generally the ordering instrument for Schedule III–V. They remain              Use assigned purchasing authority; do not treat the owner’s
                                  controlled substances: use the properly registered pharmacy’s security, records, and                ordinary grocery purchasing authority as a drug-inventory
                                  authorized-purchasing controls.                                                                     authorization.

  Noncontrolled business          Ordinary business purchasing may be signed under entity authority. Prescription-drug                Separate general procurement permissions from pharmacy
  goods                           purchasing still must be for the licensed entity and within assigned authority; it is not           inventory permissions.
                                  professional authority.

  Receipt / discrepancy           The pharmacy must maintain required controlled-substance receipt, reconciliation, security, and     Match shipment to authorized order records; secure product
                                  record controls. Owner involvement never replaces them.                                             and escalate a discrepancy to PIC and controlled-substance
                                                                                                                                      compliance.


  If authority is unavailable
  LAW — must: stop the regulated action until current authority is confirmed. Do not “borrow” a signature, credential, registration, or other store’s DEA
  authority. Escalate: PIC/pharmacy operations for immediate practice and inventory controls; controlled-substance compliance for Form 222, CSOS, POA,
  registration, or alternate-supply questions. A currently authorized person may act only within current scope. A lawful transfer, alternate supplier process,
  or delay may be considered only when permitted and approved—not promised in every circumstance.

  POA lifecycle
  LAW — must: controlled-substance POA is a documented grant from the DEA registrant, retained with required records, revocable, and limited to its
  scope. Check it; do not infer it from job title. GOLDFINCH SAFEGUARD: retain a status check showing grant, scope, location, revocation/termination
  review, and reviewer.




Internal compliance resource — not a substitute for regulator, counsel, or board review for a specific transaction.                                                                                Page 2
 GOLDFINCH SYSTEMS | FRANCHISE AUTHORITY                                                                                                                   Operational guide • current through 01 Oct 2025



  State structure, ownership & professional accountability
  Minnesota                                                                                                   North Dakota

  LAW — must: Nonpharmacist ownership can be part of a lawful structure, but it does not                      LAW — must: Pharmacist-ownership restrictions apply. A new nonpharmacist grocery
  confer professional, DEA, or PHI authority. The pharmacy must remain licensed, have an                      owner cannot assume a franchise agreement authorizes pharmacy ownership or operation.
  appropriately licensed PIC, and meet applicable ownership/applicant disclosure and                          Any statutory exception, grandfathered arrangement, or board-approved structure is
  operational requirements. Confirm state action before a location, owner/entity, control, or                 entity-specific and nontransferable without verification. Before any
  PIC change; it may require notice, approval, or a new application.                                          ownership/control/entity/PIC change, obtain Board/legal review of the approved structure
                                                                                                              and required filing/approval.


   TIME CHECK — 1 Jan 2024 → 1 Oct 2025: The reviewed core rules on DEA location/signer authority, Form 222/CSOS/POA, HIPAA
   role-based minimum-necessary access, PIC accountability, Minnesota nonpharmacist ownership posture, and North Dakota
   pharmacist-ownership restrictions remained materially stable for this guide. The post-signature-incident default-off workflow,
   independent verification, revalidation, and exception record are Goldfinch policy clarifications, not claimed changes in law.


  Patient information: visibility without browsing
  LAW — must: Ownership does not create a right to view patient names, prescriptions, profiles, claims, counseling information, or other PHI. Internal
  access requires covered-entity workforce status, an assigned permissible pharmacy/health-care function, authorization, and the minimum amount
  needed. Access must be controlled and auditable; suspected unauthorized access is reported promptly. Disclosure to an outside owner, adviser, affiliate,
  or service provider needs an appropriate legal basis. A business-associate relationship is service-limited, not blanket browsing permission.
  Not sufficient by itself: curiosity; employee, family, or personal relationship; a dispute; marketing; general owner oversight; or confidentiality promise.
  GOLDFINCH SAFEGUARD: meet ordinary owner oversight with aggregate, de-identified, limited, or otherwise role-appropriate business reporting.
  Patient-level access is a documented, role-approved exception only when the function and minimum necessary scope are established.

  If the purpose or authority is unclear
  LAW — must: withhold access or disclosure; do not decide a novel privacy question at the counter. Preserve only needed request facts, then route to
  privacy/security review. Resume only after documented role/purpose/access approval or another valid legal basis. GOLDFINCH SAFEGUARD: retain a
  concise exception record without PHI beyond what review needs.




Internal compliance resource — not a substitute for regulator, counsel, or board review for a specific transaction.                                                                               Page 3
 GOLDFINCH SYSTEMS | FRANCHISE AUTHORITY                                                                                                                     Operational guide • current through 01 Oct 2025



  Use this operating model
  1 | Identify the action                                                 2 | Confirm the authority                                         3 | Act or stop

  Is it entity business, pharmacy/permit, Schedule II,                    Check local license/permit; local DEA registration;               If current authority is verified, proceed within scope. If
  Schedule III–V, receipt, PIC/professional practice, or PHI?             POA/signer and personal CSOS status; assigned                     unavailable, expired, revoked, unverified, or disputed: stop,
                                                                          workforce role/purpose/minimum necessary; or state                preserve limited facts, route to the listed function, and
                                                                          ownership approval, as applicable.                                release only on objective confirmation or approved lawful
                                                                                                                                            alternative.



  Escalation routes & release conditions
  Question / stop                                                     Route                                                     Release only when

  Form 222, CSOS, POA, DEA registration,                              PIC / pharmacy operations, then controlled-substance      Current registrant-linked authority and personal credential are verified,
  controlled-substance order or receipt                               compliance                                                or the responsible function documents a lawful alternative.

  Owner/entity/control/PIC/permit status, especially North            Pharmacy legal / regulatory affairs and state Board       The applicable state structure and filing/approval status are verified
  Dakota                                                              review as directed                                        before closing or implementation.

  PIC conflict or instruction contrary to practice law                PIC, pharmacy operations, and compliance/legal as         A lawful resolution preserves the PIC’s professional judgment and
                                                                      needed                                                    accountability.

  PHI request, access, or disclosure purpose uncertain                Privacy officer / information security review             Documented role, purpose, minimum-necessary scope and access
                                                                                                                                approval, or other valid disclosure basis.


  Authority base
  Federal: 21 U.S.C. §822; 21 CFR §§1301.12, 1305.03, 1305.05, 1305.21–.28; HIPAA Privacy/Security Rules, 45 CFR §§164.502, .504(e), .514(d), .308(a)(3), .312. Minnesota:
  Minn. Stat. ch. 151 (including §151.252) and Minn. R. ch. 6800. North Dakota: N.D.C.C. ch. 43-15 (including §43-15-35) and N.D. Admin. Code tit. 61. Confirm current Board and
  DEA instructions for a specific filing or transaction.
  Companion tools: State Authority Matrix (action-by-state conditions and sources) and Authority Exception Card (immediate stop/verify/escalate/release).




Internal compliance resource — not a substitute for regulator, counsel, or board review for a specific transaction.                                                                                  Page 4

criteria.description: 所有三个必需的文件都存在于顶层，位于确切请求的文件名下，并以其本机格式成功打开。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认确切的文件名，验证子目录中没有嵌套文件，然后打开或解析每个工件。重命名、损坏或格式不匹配的工件不满足此项要求。

original.criterion: All three required files exist at the top level under the exact requested filenames and open successfully in their native formats.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the exact filenames, verify that no file is nested in a subdirectory, and open or parse each artifact. A renamed, corrupt, or format-mismatched artifact does not satisfy this item.

criteria.description: 呈现的用户指南不超过四页。
criteria.grader_hint: 计算渲染的 PDF 页面数，包括标题页、源注释、附录和故意留白的页面。

original.criterion: The rendered owner guide is no more than four pages.
original.grader_hint: Count rendered PDF pages, including title pages, source notes, appendices, and intentionally blank pages.

criteria.description: 呈现的异常卡占用的空间不超过一页，并且保持清晰，不会剪切或重叠内容。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用标准 Office 渲染器渲染 DOCX 并检查生成的页数和易读性。

original.criterion: The rendered exception card occupies no more than one page and remains legible without clipped or overlapping content.
original.grader_hint: Render the DOCX using a standard office renderer and inspect the resulting page count and legibility.

criteria.description: 状态矩阵是一个功能电子表格，其操作单元是可读的，并且其状态/动作记录可以在不破坏意义的情况下进行排序或过滤。
criteria.grader_hint: 打开工作簿并验证决策内容是否存储为单元格而不是粘贴的图像，标题是否仍与记录相关联，并且普通排序或过滤是否实用。

original.criterion: The state matrix is a functional spreadsheet whose operative cells are readable and whose state/action records can be sorted or filtered without destroying meaning.
original.grader_hint: Open the workbook and verify that the decision content is stored as cells rather than a pasted image, that headers remain associated with records, and that ordinary sorting or filtering is practical.

criteria.description: 该一揽子计划将明尼苏达州、北达科他州和适用的联邦法律确定为其范围，并指出评估有效期截至 10 月1、2025。
criteria.grader_hint: 在指南中查找明确的管辖范围和截止日期，并在矩阵中查找兼容的范围或生效日期字段。

original.criterion: The package identifies Minnesota, North Dakota, and applicable federal law as its scope and states that the assessment is current through October 1, 2025.
original.grader_hint: Look for an explicit jurisdictional scope and as-of date in the guide and a compatible scope or effective-date field in the matrix.

criteria.description: 该指南将一月1、2024的相关权威立场与十月1、2025的立场进行比较，而不是仅仅显示这两个日期。
criteria.grader_hint: 进行简洁的比较，说明哪些所有者权限域发生了重大变化或保持不变，以及这在操作上意味着什么。

original.criterion: The guide compares the relevant authority position at January 1, 2024 with the position at October 1, 2025 rather than merely displaying both dates.
original.grader_hint: Credit a concise comparison that states which owner-authority domains materially changed or remained unchanged and what that means operationally.

criteria.description: 期间比较将法律或监管变化与签名事件引发的金翅雀政策澄清区分开来，并不是仅仅为了填充比较而发明法律变化。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查内部控制变更是否已标记为此类，以及任何声称的法律变更均得到准确的授权和生效日期的支持。接受审查的域没有发生重大变化的合理声明是可以接受的。

original.criterion: The period comparison distinguishes legal or regulatory changes from Goldfinch policy clarifications prompted by the signature incident and does not invent a legal change merely to populate the comparison.
original.grader_hint: Check that a change in internal controls is labeled as such and that any claimed change in law is supported by an accurate authority and effective date. A defensible statement that a reviewed domain did not materially change is acceptable.

criteria.description: 该软件包对管理所有者订购权限和患者信息访问的默认操作模型提出了明确的建议。
criteria.grader_hint: 该建议必须解决默认启用的访问和权限与角色批准的访问和权限的问题。它可能允许记录异常，但不能保留未确定的默认值。

original.criterion: The package makes one clear recommendation for the default operating model governing owner ordering authority and access to patient information.
original.grader_hint: The recommendation must resolve default-enabled versus role-approved access and authority. It may allow documented exceptions, but it cannot leave the default undecided.

criteria.description: 推荐模型的合理性在于所有权、药房或 DEA 注册、PIC 责任、分配的工作职责和最低限度的必要隐私访问之间的分离。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找与实际合规机制相关的简洁理由，而不是对更严格或更宽松的访问的不受支持的偏好。

original.criterion: The recommended model is justified by the separation among ownership, pharmacy or DEA registration, PIC accountability, assigned job duties, and minimum-necessary privacy access.
original.grader_hint: Look for a concise rationale tied to the actual compliance mechanics rather than an unsupported preference for tighter or looser access.

criteria.description: 法律强制性要求和金翅雀保障措施有着明显且一致的区别。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受清晰的标签，例如必须、法律、要求、金翅雀控制或建议的保障措施。不要相信模糊的建议，因为这些建议会让业主无法判断该声明是否具有法律强制性。

original.criterion: Legally mandatory requirements and Goldfinch safeguards are visibly and consistently differentiated.
original.grader_hint: Accept clear labels such as must, law, required, Goldfinch control, or recommended safeguard. Do not credit vague advice that leaves an owner unable to tell whether a statement is legally compulsory.

criteria.description: 该指南区分了特许经营权所有者、药房许可证或许可证持有者、DEA 注册人、主管药剂师、药剂师、授权购买者或签署人、员工以及相关业务伙伴。
criteria.grader_hint: 这些术语不必出现在术语表中，但它们各自的法律和操作功能必须易于理解，并且不得被分解为单一的所有者权限概念。

original.criterion: The guide distinguishes the franchise owner, pharmacy permit or license holder, DEA registrant, pharmacist-in-charge, pharmacist, authorized purchaser or signer, workforce member, and business associate where relevant.
original.grader_hint: The terms need not appear in a glossary, but their separate legal and operational functions must be understandable and must not be collapsed into a single concept of owner authority.

criteria.description: 该指南明确指出，特许经营权、公司所有权、支票签署权或资金责任本身并不赋予药房专业、管制物质订购或 PHI 访问权。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻求将商业权力与监管权力明确分开，而不仅仅是警告要小心。

original.criterion: The guide clearly states that franchise ownership, corporate title, check-signing authority, or funding responsibility does not by itself confer pharmacy-professional, controlled-substance ordering, or PHI-access authority.
original.grader_hint: Look for an affirmative separation of business authority from regulated authority, not merely a warning to be careful.

criteria.description: 该指南解释说，药房执照或许可取决于持照药房、经批准的所有者或经营实体以及地点，而特许经营隶属关系本身并不是许可证。
criteria.grader_hint: 信用语言阻止所有者将系统范围的特许经营关系或其他商店的权限视为可转让给当地药房。

original.criterion: The guide explains that pharmacy licensure or permitting attaches to the licensed pharmacy, approved owner or operating entity, and location, and that franchise affiliation alone is not the license.
original.grader_hint: Credit language that prevents an owner from treating a system-wide franchise relationship or another store's authority as transferable to the local pharmacy.

criteria.description: 该指南解释说，每个处理受控物质的零售药店必须在适当的 DEA 注册下运营，并且不能使用其他商店的注册作为替代。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查单独注册或定位原则，并确保矩阵不暗示系统范围或所有者范围的 DEA 权限。

original.criterion: The guide explains that each retail pharmacy location handling controlled substances must operate under the appropriate DEA registration and that another store's registration cannot be used as a substitute.
original.grader_hint: Check for the separate-registration or location principle and ensure the matrix does not imply system-wide or owner-wide DEA authority.

criteria.description: 该软件包准确地将 DEA 表格222 限制为订购附表 I 或 II 受控物质，并适用于零售药房环境，但并不意味着普通采购订单签名就足够了。
criteria.grader_hint: 该指南应使船东能够理解附表 II 的订购，同时保留表格 222 的权限要求。零售药店通常不订购附表 I 产品，但仍可能准确描述法律范围。

original.criterion: The package accurately limits DEA Form 222 to ordering Schedule I or II controlled substances and applies the retail-pharmacy context without implying that an ordinary purchase-order signature is sufficient.
original.grader_hint: The guide should make Schedule II ordering understandable to an owner while preserving the Form 222 authority requirement. Retail pharmacies ordinarily do not order Schedule I products, but the legal scope may still be described accurately.

criteria.description: CSOS 被准确地描述为一种用于受控物质订单的电子方法，该方法仍然需要有效的注册相关权限和个人证书，而不是共享商店凭证。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅当电子订购未被描述为绕过表格 222 权威概念并且数字证书被视为证书持有者的个人证书时，才可获得信用。

original.criterion: CSOS is accurately presented as an electronic method for controlled-substance orders that still requires valid registration-linked authority and an individual certificate rather than a shared store credential.
original.grader_hint: Credit only if electronic ordering is not described as bypassing Form 222 authority concepts and the digital credential is treated as personal to the certificate holder.

criteria.description: 该指南解释说，签署 DEA 表格222 订单的人必须是注册人或持有根据 DEA 要求签署的有效授权书才能签署。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据 DEA 注册人的授权书寻找签署前的顺序和授权，而不仅仅是特许经营权所有者、经理或 PIC 的许可。

original.criterion: The guide explains that a person signing DEA Form 222 orders must be the registrant or hold a valid power of attorney executed under DEA requirements before signing.
original.grader_hint: Look for the before-signing sequence and for authority based on the DEA registrant's power of attorney, not merely permission from a franchise owner, manager, or PIC.

criteria.description: 该方案将受控物质授权书描述为一份记录在案的、保留的和可撤销的授权书，其范围必须经过检查，而不是根据职称假定。
criteria.grader_hint: 操作说明应支持确认拨款及其当前状态。它不需要复制授权书表格。

original.criterion: The package describes controlled-substance power of attorney as a documented, retained, and revocable grant whose scope must be checked rather than assumed from job title.
original.grader_hint: The operational explanation should support confirming the grant and its current status. It need not reproduce a power-of-attorney form.

criteria.description: 该软件包明确禁止签署他人的姓名、出借或使用他人的 CSOS 证书或凭据，或将复制的签名视为授权。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证该禁令是否足够直接，可供业主或一线员工在紧急订单期间申请，并作为立即停止条件出现在例外卡中。

original.criterion: The package unambiguously prohibits signing another person's name, lending or using another person's CSOS certificate or credentials, or treating a copied signature as authorization.
original.grader_hint: Verify that the prohibition is direct enough for an owner or frontline employee to apply during an urgent order and appears in the exception card as an immediate stop condition.

criteria.description: 该指南涉及当雇佣、角色、授权、注册、证书或其他相关状态结束或变化时撤销或丧失订购权的问题。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻求立即停止使用和更新或撤销访问的要求，而不是允许授权继续进行，直到定期审查。

original.criterion: The guide addresses revocation or loss of ordering authority when employment, role, authorization, registration, certificate, or other relevant status ends or changes.
original.grader_hint: Look for a requirement to stop use and update or revoke access promptly rather than allowing authority to continue until a periodic review.

criteria.description: 该指南正确区分附表 III-V 订购与附表 II 订购，但并不暗示附表 III-V 产品不受监管或可能在药房注册人的控制范围之外订购。
criteria.grader_hint: 请解释，表格222或其等效的 CSOS 通常不是附表 III-V 产品的订购工具，而受控物质注册、安全、记录和授权采购控制仍然适用。

original.criterion: The guide correctly distinguishes Schedule III–V ordering from Schedule II ordering without implying that Schedule III–V products are unregulated or may be ordered outside the pharmacy registrant's controls.
original.grader_hint: Credit an explanation that Form 222 or its CSOS equivalent is not generally the ordering instrument for Schedule III–V products while controlled-substance registration, security, record, and authorized purchasing controls still apply.

criteria.description: 该一揽子计划将普通非受控企业采购与处方药和受控物质授权区分开来，同时仍然要求购买者在指定的权限内为获得适当许可的实体行事。
criteria.grader_hint: 该指南不应暗示每次杂货购买都需要药剂师授权，也不应暗示所有者的普通购买力自动延伸到受监管的药品库存。

original.criterion: The package distinguishes ordinary noncontrolled business purchasing from prescription-drug and controlled-substance authority while still requiring the purchaser to act for the properly licensed entity and within assigned authority.
original.grader_hint: The guide should not imply either that every grocery purchase needs pharmacist authority or that an owner's ordinary purchasing power automatically extends to regulated drug inventory.

criteria.description: 该指南解决了受控物质的收货责任，包括根据授权订单记录检查发货情况并逐步升级差异，而不是让所有者参与来取代药房控制。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找下订单和药房的受控物质接收、对账、记录保存和差异流程之间的操作区别。

original.criterion: The guide addresses receipt accountability for controlled substances, including checking the shipment against authorized order records and escalating discrepancies rather than allowing owner involvement to replace pharmacy controls.
original.grader_hint: Look for an operational distinction between placing an order and the pharmacy's controlled-substance receipt, reconciliation, recordkeeping, and discrepancy process.

criteria.description: 该包解释说，即使业务任务被委托，PIC 也根据适用的药房法负责药房实践合规性、监督、安全、记录和运营。
criteria.grader_hint: 不需要这些确切的名词，但文件必须保留 PIC 的监管责任，并且不能将 PIC 描述为仅仅业主的采购代表。

original.criterion: The package explains that the PIC is accountable for pharmacy practice compliance, supervision, security, records, and operation under applicable pharmacy law even when business tasks are delegated.
original.grader_hint: Do not require those exact nouns, but the document must preserve the PIC's regulatory accountability and not portray the PIC as merely an owner's purchasing delegate.

criteria.description: 该指南规定，业主不得指示 PIC 或其他药剂师违反药房法、推翻专业判断、伪造记录或使用未经授权的签名者。
criteria.grader_hint: 在业主指示上注明直接边界。关于合作的通用语言是不够的。

original.criterion: The guide states that an owner may not direct the PIC or another pharmacist to violate pharmacy law, override professional judgment, falsify records, or use an unauthorized signer.
original.grader_hint: Credit a direct boundary on owner instructions. General language about cooperation is not enough.

criteria.description: 北达科他州的指南准确地确定了该州的药剂师所有权限制，并且没有告诉新的非药剂师杂货店主，仅特许经营协议就允许拥有或经营药房。
criteria.grader_hint: 针对 10 月生效的北达科他州药房所有权法进行审查1、2025。在业主签署所有权或许可文件之前，指南应重点关注法律批准的所有权或经营结构。

original.criterion: The North Dakota guidance accurately identifies the state's pharmacist-ownership restrictions and does not tell a new nonpharmacist grocery owner that a franchise agreement alone permits ownership or operation of the pharmacy.
original.grader_hint: Review against North Dakota pharmacy ownership law in effect on October 1, 2025. The guidance should direct attention to the legally approved ownership or operating structure before the owner signs ownership or permit documents.

criteria.description: 北达科他州指南规定了任何例外情况、祖父安排或特定于实体的批准，并要求在所有权、控制权或实体变更之前进行验证，而不是将例外情况视为一般可转让。
criteria.grader_hint: 谨慎对待遗留或法定例外情况。该计划不得暗示购买特许经营杂货店会自动继承药房所有权例外。

original.criterion: The North Dakota guidance qualifies any exception, grandfathered arrangement, or entity-specific approval and requires verification before an ownership, control, or entity change rather than presenting an exception as generally transferable.
original.grader_hint: Credit careful treatment of legacy or statutory exceptions. The package must not imply that buying a franchised grocery store automatically inherits a pharmacy ownership exception.

criteria.description: 明尼苏达州指南准确地解释了非药剂师所有权本身并不提供专业权威，并且仍然受到药房许可证、适当许可的 PIC 以及适用的披露和运营要求的约束。
criteria.grader_hint: 该矩阵应将明尼苏达州的所有权状况与北达科他州的所有权状况区分开来，而无需将明尼苏达州更宽松的所有权框架转化为不受限制的药房执业权力。

original.criterion: The Minnesota guidance accurately explains that nonpharmacist ownership does not itself provide professional authority and remains subject to pharmacy licensure, an appropriately licensed PIC, and applicable disclosure and operational requirements.
original.grader_hint: The matrix should distinguish Minnesota's ownership posture from North Dakota's without translating Minnesota's more permissive ownership framework into unrestricted pharmacy-practice authority.

criteria.description: 该计划警告称，所有权、法人实体、控制权、地点或 PIC 变更可能会触发提前通知、董事会批准、新申请或其他特定于州的行动，这些行动必须在交割或实施之前得到确认。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找变更前的验证边界，而不是普遍声称一项申请规则在两个州都同样适用。

original.criterion: The package warns that ownership, legal entity, control, location, or PIC changes may trigger advance notice, board approval, a new application, or other state-specific action that must be confirmed before closing or implementation.
original.grader_hint: Look for a pre-change verification boundary rather than a universal claim that one filing rule applies identically in both states.

criteria.description: 对于矩阵中表示的每个所有者行为，明尼苏达州和北达科他州的条目要么说明适用的差异，要么明确表明结果是相同的；依赖于国家的所有权规则并未合并为一个国家答案。
criteria.grader_hint: 逐个动作地遍历矩阵。共同的联邦规则可能会产生相同的结果，但所有权和州许可问题必须保留相关的州区别。

original.criterion: For each owner action represented in the matrix, the Minnesota and North Dakota entries either state the applicable difference or expressly show that the result is the same; state-dependent ownership rules are not merged into one national answer.
original.grader_hint: Walk the matrix action by action. A shared federal rule may produce the same result, but ownership and state-license questions must preserve the relevant state distinction.

criteria.description: 该包指出，所有权并不自动创建查看患者姓名、处方、个人资料、索赔、咨询信息或其他 PHI 的权利。
criteria.grader_hint: 规则必须直接说明，并且应该在主要解释和一线决策路径中可见。

original.criterion: The package states that ownership does not create an automatic right to view patient names, prescriptions, profiles, claims, counseling information, or other PHI.
original.grader_hint: The rule must be stated directly and should be visible in both the main explanation and the frontline decision path.

criteria.description: 内部 PHI 访问与指定的角色、允许的药房或医疗保健功能、劳动力授权以及该角色所需的最低金额相关。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅当指南将访问权限与实际职责和最低限度必要的控制联系起来，而不是依赖于就业、所有权、好奇心或一般保密承诺时，才值得信任。

original.criterion: Internal PHI access is tied to an assigned role, a permissible pharmacy or health-care function, workforce authorization, and the minimum amount needed for that role.
original.grader_hint: Credit only if the guide links access to actual duties and minimum-necessary controls rather than relying on employment, ownership, curiosity, or a general confidentiality promise.

criteria.description: 该指南正确区分了在所涵盖实体的员工队伍中行事的所有者与作为业务伙伴提供服务的单独个人或实体，并且不将业务伙伴协议视为浏览 PHI 的一揽子许可。
criteria.grader_hint: 在任一状态下查找角色和服务限制的访问。业务伙伴协议不应作为与合同功能无关的访问权的解决方案。

original.criterion: The guide correctly distinguishes an owner acting within the covered entity's workforce from a separate person or entity performing services as a business associate and does not treat a business associate agreement as blanket permission to browse PHI.
original.grader_hint: Look for role- and service-limited access in either status. A business associate agreement should not be presented as the cure for access unrelated to contracted functions.

criteria.description: 该指南通过汇总、去识别化、有限或其他适合角色的业务报告，为合法所有者的可见性提供了一条实用的途径，而不是假设患者级别的访问是必要的。
criteria.grader_hint: 归功于一种运营替代方案，它可以让所有者监督业务绩效，同时最大限度地减少患者信息。该文件不需要规定特定的软件报告。

original.criterion: The guide provides a practical path for legitimate owner visibility through aggregate, de-identified, limited, or otherwise role-appropriate business reporting instead of assuming patient-level access is necessary.
original.grader_hint: Credit an operational alternative that lets owners oversee business performance while minimizing patient information. The document need not prescribe a particular software report.

criteria.description: 该方案将好奇心、员工或家庭关系、纠纷、营销和一般所有者监督视为在没有单独许可依据的情况下访问患者记录的充分理由。
criteria.grader_hint: 同等简洁的例子是可以接受的，但材料必须明确个人利益和广泛的商业状况不是治疗、付款或医疗保健运营目的。

original.criterion: The package identifies curiosity, employee or family relationships, disputes, marketing, and general owner oversight as insufficient reasons to access a patient's record without a separate permitted basis.
original.grader_hint: Equivalent concise examples are acceptable, but the material must make clear that personal interest and broad business status are not treatment, payment, or health-care operations purposes.

criteria.description: 该指南区分了基于角色的内部访问与向外部所有者、顾问、附属机构或服务提供商披露 PHI，并要求后者有适当的法律依据。
criteria.grader_hint: 该文档不得将所有所有者查看描述为内部访问。寻求认识到实体和员工状况会影响信息是在内部使用还是在外部披露。

original.criterion: The guide distinguishes internal role-based access from disclosure of PHI to an outside owner, adviser, affiliate, or service provider and requires an appropriate legal basis for the latter.
original.grader_hint: The document must not describe all owner viewing as internal access. Look for recognition that entity and workforce status affect whether information is being used internally or disclosed externally.

criteria.description: 该软件包规定，PHI 访问受到访问控制、日志记录或可审核性的约束，并及时报告可疑的未经授权的访问。
criteria.grader_hint: 该指南应解决预防和响应问题，而不包括系统特定的点击说明。

original.criterion: The package states that PHI access is subject to access controls, logging or auditability, and prompt reporting of suspected unauthorized access.
original.grader_hint: The guide should address both prevention and response without including system-specific click instructions.

criteria.description: 当没有授权的附表 II 签署人或有效的 CSOS 证书可用时，该软件包会指示工作人员不要以其他人的身份完成或重新创建受控物质订单，并提供合法的升级或替代供应路径。
criteria.grader_hint: 该路径可能包括联系 PIC 或合规部门、使用另一个当前授权的签名人、在允许的情况下安排合法转移或替代供应商流程，或者延迟订单。它不能承诺在任何情况下每一种替代方案都是合法可用的。

original.criterion: When no authorized Schedule II signer or valid CSOS certificate is available, the package directs staff not to complete or recreate the controlled-substance order under someone else's identity and provides a lawful escalation or alternate-supply path.
original.grader_hint: The path may include contacting the PIC or compliance function, using another currently authorized signer, arranging a lawful transfer or alternate supplier process where permitted, or delaying the order. It must not promise that every alternative is legally available in every circumstance.

criteria.description: 例外路径单独解决过期、撤销、不可用或无法验证的权限，并在恢复工作之前需要当前确认。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找停止、验证、升级和发布的顺序。如果经理的权限也不明确，那么仅仅告诉员工去询问经理是不够的。

original.criterion: The exception path separately addresses expired, revoked, unavailable, or unverifiable authority and requires current confirmation before work resumes.
original.grader_hint: Look for a stop, verification, escalation, and release sequence. Merely telling staff to ask a manager is insufficient if the manager's authority is also unknown.

criteria.description: 当 PHI 访问的目的或权限不确定时，该软件包会指示工作人员拒绝访问或披露、保留请求详细信息，并升级进行隐私审查。
criteria.grader_hint: 该路径必须适用于业主在柜台提出的请求，并且不应告诉一线员工自行决定新的隐私问题。

original.criterion: When the purpose or authority for PHI access is uncertain, the package directs staff to withhold access or disclosure, preserve the request details, and escalate for privacy review.
original.grader_hint: The path must work for an owner request made at the counter and should not tell frontline staff to decide a novel privacy question by themselves.

criteria.description: 紧迫性、库存压力、财务所有权、供应商截止日期或所有者指示被明确视为不足以绕过受控物质、许可或隐私机构要求。
criteria.grader_hint: 归功于直接的禁止绕行规则，该规则适用于正常程序无法完成时可能出现的实际压力。

original.criterion: Urgency, inventory pressure, financial ownership, a vendor deadline, or an owner's instruction is expressly treated as insufficient to bypass controlled-substance, licensing, or privacy authority requirements.
original.grader_hint: Credit a direct no-bypass rule that applies to the practical pressures likely to arise when the normal procedure cannot be completed.

criteria.description: 例外卡将受控物质订购、国家所有权或许可问题、PIC 冲突和 PHI 问题路由到适当不同的职能或角色持有者。

original.criterion: The exception card routes controlled-substance ordering, state ownership or permit questions, PIC conflicts, and PHI questions to appropriately different functions or role-holders.
original.grader_hint: Named individuals and phone numbers are not required, but the card must distinguish routes such as PIC or pharmacy operations, controlled-substance compliance, board or legal review, and privacy or security review.

criteria.description: 例外路径告诉一线用户要保留哪些事实和记录，而无需复制不必要的 PHI 或受控物质凭证。
criteria.grader_hint: 有用的事实包括请求者、请求的操作、存储、时间、检查的权限、凭证状态、文档或订单标识符以及处置。患者详细信息应仅限于升级真正需要的内容。

original.criterion: The exception path tells the frontline user what facts and records to preserve without copying unnecessary PHI or controlled-substance credentials.
original.grader_hint: Useful facts include requester, requested action, store, time, authority checked, credential status, document or order identifier, and disposition. Patient detail should be limited to what the escalation genuinely requires.

criteria.description: 例外卡为未经授权的签名、共享凭证、未经验证的所有权或许可权限以及不合理的 PHI 访问提供了立即、明确无误的停止条件。
criteria.grader_hint: 一线读者应该能够一眼识别出这些情况，并知道不要继续。

original.criterion: The exception card gives immediate, unmistakable stop conditions for unauthorized signatures, shared credentials, unverified ownership or permit authority, and unjustified PHI access.
original.grader_hint: A frontline reader should be able to identify these conditions at a glance and know not to proceed.

criteria.description: 例外卡规定了恢复操作的客观释放条件，例如经过验证的当前权限、批准的合法替代方案或记录在案的隐私批准。
criteria.grader_hint: 该卡不得无限期暂停该操作或允许同一请求者自行批准。释放条件应与停止原因相对应。

original.criterion: The exception card states objective release conditions for resuming the action, such as verified current authority, an approved lawful alternative, or documented privacy approval.
original.grader_hint: The card must not leave the action suspended indefinitely or allow the same requester to self-approve. The release condition should correspond to the reason for the stop.

criteria.description: 状态矩阵至少涵盖以下内容：药房所有权或许可证状态、州申请签名、非管制药品采购、二类管制药品订购、三至五类管制药品订购、CSOS使用、管制药品授权书（POA）、PIC决策、患者级受保护健康信息（PHI）、业务报告，以及针对两个州的例外情况升级流程。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅当矩阵为明尼苏达州和北达科他州均提供可用结果或条件时，才将该行动计为已覆盖。可接受等效的行动名称。

original.criterion: The state matrix covers, at minimum, pharmacy ownership or permit status, state application signatures, noncontrolled purchasing, Schedule II ordering, Schedule III–V ordering, CSOS use, controlled-substance power of attorney, PIC decisions, patient-level PHI, business reporting, and exception escalation for both states.
original.grader_hint: Count an action as covered only if the matrix gives a usable result or condition for both Minnesota and North Dakota. Equivalent action names are acceptable.

criteria.description: 矩阵和指南识别出联邦DEA、HIPAA、明尼苏达州和北达科他州命题的可信管辖机构及生效日期，且不会用未经解释的引用文本给所有者增加负担。
criteria.grader_hint: 对照1年2025日有效的权威法规验证实质性命题。预期来源类别包括《管制物质法》及21 CFR第1301和第1305部分、HIPAA隐私与安全规则、明尼苏达州药房法规与规章，以及北达科他州药房法规与行政规章。精确引用或链接很有帮助，但必须准确无误。

original.criterion: The matrix and guide identify credible controlling authorities and effective dates for the federal DEA, HIPAA, Minnesota, and North Dakota propositions without burdening owners with unexplained citation text.
original.grader_hint: Validate material propositions against authorities in force on October 1, 2025. Expected source families include the Controlled Substances Act and 21 CFR Parts 1301 and 1305, the HIPAA Privacy and Security Rules, Minnesota pharmacy statutes and rules, and North Dakota pharmacy statutes and administrative rules. Pinpoint references or links are helpful but must be accurate.

criteria.description: 例外卡片和状态矩阵中陈述的每一条法律结果或条件，均须与所有者指南中的详细解释保持一致。
criteria.grader_hint: 交叉核对共同主题，特别是北达科他州的所有权、明尼苏达州的所有者权限、222表格、CSOS、授权书（POA）、PIC界限、PHI访问权限以及停止条件。只有当简化不会反转或在实质上扩大规则时，方可接受简化。

original.criterion: Every legal result or condition stated in the exception card and state matrix agrees with the fuller explanation in the owner guide.
original.grader_hint: Cross-check shared topics, especially North Dakota ownership, Minnesota owner authority, Form 222, CSOS, power of attorney, PIC boundaries, PHI access, and stop conditions. Simplification is acceptable only if it does not reverse or materially broaden the rule.

criteria.description: 推荐的默认模型以及“必须”与“保障措施”标签在指南、矩阵和例外卡片中保持一致。
criteria.grader_hint: 在一个文件中被标记为Goldfinch政策的控制措施，不得在另一个文件中呈现为法定要求；任何快速参考说明都不得悄悄启用指南规定为基于例外的权限。

original.criterion: The recommended default model and the must-versus-safeguard labels remain consistent across the guide, matrix, and exception card.
original.grader_hint: A control labeled as Goldfinch policy in one file must not be presented as statutory law in another, and no quick-reference instruction may silently enable authority that the guide makes exception-based.

criteria.description: 该资料包内容具体、语言通俗、视觉导航清晰，可供非药剂师所有者或一线员工使用而无需向作者提出后续问题，同时最大限度地减少敏感信息的暴露。
criteria.grader_hint: 将资料包作为一个整体运营系统进行评估。它应定义不可避免的技术术语，使用果断的行动语言，使州际差异易于查找，避免未经解释的法律引文，不包含患者示例或不必要的PHI，并提供足够的背景信息以确保安全操作。

original.criterion: The package is specific, plain-language, visually navigable, and usable by a nonpharmacist owner or frontline employee without asking the author a follow-up question, while minimizing sensitive information.
original.grader_hint: Assess the package as an operational whole. It should define unavoidable technical terms, use decisive action language, make state differences easy to find, avoid unexplained legal quotations, contain no patient examples or unnecessary PHI, and provide enough context to act safely.

criteria.description: 该资料包区分了所有者或实体在真实业务和许可提交文件上的签名，与保留给PIC、药剂师、DEA注册人或特定授权签署人的声明。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找可用的边界：所有者仅在表格要求由所有者或申请人签署且签署人拥有实体权限时方可签署文件，但不得仅因所有者控制业务就签署专业、注册人或PIC声明。

original.criterion: The package distinguishes owner or entity signatures on truthful business and licensing submissions from attestations reserved to the PIC, pharmacist, DEA registrant, or specifically authorized signer.
original.grader_hint: Look for a usable boundary: an owner may sign a document only when the form calls for the owner or applicant and the signer has entity authority, but may not sign professional, registrant, or PIC attestations merely because the owner controls the business.

spec.professional_context: Goldfinch Systems operates a multistate retail-pharmacy franchise network whose nonpharmacist owners need to act without confusing business ownership, pharmacy licensure, DEA authority, professional accountability, or access to protected health information. The package will be used by owners and frontline pharmacy personnel in decisions carrying controlled-substance, privacy, licensure, and patient-safety consequences.
difficulty_sources: Translating controlled-substance ordering authority into plain language without falsely stating that nonpharmacist owners can never participate
Separating pharmacy ownership, entity authority, DEA registration, PIC accountability, and individual signer credentials
Reconciling Minnesota and North Dakota lay-ownership rules without assuming entity-specific exceptions
Drawing a visible boundary between legal mandates and prudent enterprise safeguards
Providing a safe and usable path when authority or credentials cannot be confirmed
Keeping three dependent artifacts legally and operationally consistent under tight page limits

authoring_plan.solver_instance: A retail-pharmacy compliance pharmacist must convert federal controlled-substance rules, HIPAA role-based access requirements, and materially different Minnesota and North Dakota pharmacy ownership rules into three dependent tools for nonpharmacist owners and frontline staff.
authoring_plan.intended_verdict: Recommend an exception-based, role-approved model: ownership alone enables neither controlled-substance ordering authority nor patient-level information access. Business visibility should ordinarily be met with aggregate, de-identified, limited, or otherwise role-appropriate reporting. Any ordering or PHI access granted to an owner must arise from a genuine assigned function, current documentation, and the applicable regulated authority.

legal_scope.change_assessment: The gold should identify whether any reviewed rule materially changed between the comparison dates. It must not manufacture a legal change. If domain review confirms that the core ownership, DEA signer, PIC-accountability, and minimum-necessary authority rules remained materially stable, say so and separately identify the post-incident Goldfinch control clarification as an internal change.

core_relationships: Franchise ownership or corporate title is not equivalent to being the licensed pharmacy entity, DEA registrant, PIC, pharmacist, authorized controlled-substance purchaser, workforce member, or authorized PHI user.

Each controlled-substance-handling retail pharmacy location requires the appropriate DEA registration; authority from another store is not portable merely because both stores share branding or ownership.
Schedule II orders require the registrant or a person holding valid DEA power of attorney to execute the applicable Form 222 or CSOS order. CSOS credentials are individual and may not be shared.
Schedule III–V orders do not generally use Form 222, but remain within the pharmacy registrant's controlled-substance, security, recordkeeping, and authorized-purchasing framework.

A controlled-substance power of attorney must exist before the signer acts, be retained with the required records, be checked for current scope, and cease to support ordering after revocation or relevant termination.

The PIC may delegate tasks where lawful, but regulatory accountability and professional judgment are not transferred to the business owner. An owner cannot direct unlawful practice or sign a PIC or pharmacist attestation.
Minnesota permits nonpharmacist ownership structures subject to pharmacy licensure and PIC requirements; this does not confer professional, DEA, or PHI authority.

North Dakota imposes pharmacist-ownership restrictions. Any statutory exception, grandfathered status, or board-approved structure is entity-specific and must not be assumed to transfer with a franchise or grocery ownership change.

An owner or entity representative may sign a business or licensing submission only when the form calls for that owner or applicant signature, the signer has authority for the entity, and the statement is truthful. This does not permit the owner to sign registrant, PIC, pharmacist, or authorized-purchaser attestations.

Ownership does not create a HIPAA right to browse patient-level data. Internal access depends on workforce status, assigned duties, permissible purpose, authorization, and minimum necessary access; external service access requires an appropriate legal relationship and remains function-limited.
Business-associate status or an agreement does not create blanket access unrelated to contracted services.
Owner oversight should default to reporting that avoids patient-level PHI where the business purpose can be met with aggregate, de-identified, limited, or otherwise minimized information.
Urgency, vendor deadlines, financial loss, or owner instruction cannot cure missing legal authority or credentials.

If authority cannot be confirmed, the operational result is stop, preserve limited relevant facts, escalate to the appropriate regulated function, and resume only after objective confirmation or approval of a lawful alternative.

must: Use only a current authorized signer and the signer's own credentials.
Do not access or disclose PHI without a permissible, role-based basis.
Do not allow owner direction to override PIC accountability or professional judgment.
Comply with the applicable state's ownership, licensure, permit, and change-approval rules.
Stop and escalate when regulated authority cannot be confirmed.
should_as_goldfinch_safeguards: Default owner ordering authority and patient-level access to disabled until role approval is documented.
Independently verify a new signer or access grant before activation.
Periodically revalidate powers of attorney, CSOS access, role assignments, and owner access.
Use minimized business reports instead of patient-level data whenever they meet the oversight need.
Maintain a concise exception record showing what was requested, what authority was checked, who decided, and the disposition.
must_should_boundary.labeling_rule: The gold must not misstate these internal safeguards as universal statutory mandates, even when they are prudent enterprise controls.

failure_paths: No authorized Schedule II signer is present.
A CSOS certificate is expired, revoked, unavailable, or belongs to another person.
A power of attorney cannot be located or its current validity is uncertain.
An owner requests patient-level information but the role, purpose, workforce status, or disclosure basis is unclear.
A North Dakota ownership or control change may affect an exception or approved entity structure.
An owner and PIC disagree about a regulated action.
The normal process cannot be completed before an inventory or vendor deadline.
source_families_to_validate: Controlled Substances Act registration requirements and 21 CFR Part 1301, including separate registration principles
21 CFR Part 1305 provisions governing DEA Form 222, powers of attorney, and CSOS orders
HIPAA Privacy and Security Rules, including 45 CFR 164.502, minimum necessary provisions, workforce controls, safeguards, and business-associate limitations
Minnesota pharmacy statutes and rules governing pharmacy licensure, ownership or applicant disclosures, PIC responsibilities, and changes affecting a pharmacy license
North Dakota pharmacy statutes and administrative rules governing pharmacy ownership, permits, exceptions, PIC responsibilities, and ownership or control changes

dependent_outputs.owner_guide: Carries the complete explanation, recommendation, period comparison, must-versus-safeguard distinction, state differences, authority rules, failure paths, and concise source support.
dependent_outputs.state_matrix: Transforms the guide into action-by-state decisions. It must cover ownership or permits, who may sign, noncontrolled and controlled ordering, CSOS, power of attorney, PIC authority, PHI, business reporting, escalation, legal basis, and effective date.
dependent_outputs.exception_card: Transforms the same rules into immediate stop, verify, escalate, preserve, and release instructions for frontline use when authority cannot be confirmed.
dependent_outputs.consistency_rule: The matrix and card may simplify wording but may not broaden authority, omit a decisive state distinction, change a must into a recommendation, or contradict the guide's default model.

sensitive_information_controls: Do not include patient scenarios, names, prescription details, store credentials, DEA numbers, permit numbers, or copied signatures.
Use role and document categories rather than realistic patient-level examples.
Exception records should capture only the facts needed for compliance review and should never copy passwords, private keys, CSOS credentials, or unnecessary PHI.
authoring_plan.offline_build_validation: A reference solution can be created and checked offline with a word processor, spreadsheet library, PDF renderer, and a pharmacist-maintained legal knowledge base current through the stated date. Render the PDF and DOCX, inspect page caps, parse the workbook, and walk every shared proposition across all three artifacts.

constraints: No more than four rendered pages; current through October 1, 2025; compares the applicable position with January 1, 2024; excludes patient examples and software click-through instructions.

constraints: Must be readable as an operational matrix and remain consistent with the guide and exception card.

original_instruction:
You’re the pharmacist compliance lead for Goldfinch Systems. After a franchise owner used a signature they were not authorized to give on a pharmacy inventory order, Linnea Rutkowski wants a guide in all thirty owners’ hands before the January meeting. Most owners are grocers, not pharmacists, and the stores are split between Minnesota and North Dakota. Owners want operational visibility, while PICs are treating the owner title as either full authority or no authority at all. Estelle Marchetti also needs your recommendation on whether ordering and patient-information access should be enabled by default or only after role approval. Cover the law as of October 1, 2025, with a concise comparison to January 1, 2024. Make clear which requirements are mandatory and which are Goldfinch safeguards; owners must also know what happens when an urgent order cannot be completed because authority or credentials are unavailable. Produce `franchise_owner_authority_guide.pdf` of no more than four pages, `state_authority_matrix.xlsx`, and a one-page `authority_exception_card.docx`. Keep patient examples and system click-throughs out. Write all three files into the top level of the working directory using exactly those filenames, and make them usable together without a follow-up call.

---

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `franchise_owner_authority_guide.pdf` — Plain-language franchise owner guide covering signing, ordering, information access, state differences, changes over time, and the recommended authority model. (No more than four rendered pages; current through October 1, 2025; compares the applicable position with January 1, 2024; excludes patient examples and software click-through instructions.)
- `state_authority_matrix.xlsx` — Usable state-by-state authority matrix supporting owner, PIC, controlled-substance ordering, licensing, and information-access decisions. (Must be readable as an operational matrix and remain consistent with the guide and exception card.)
- `authority_exception_card.docx` — One-page frontline decision aid for situations in which authority, credentials, or permissible access cannot be confirmed. (Exactly one rendered page or less; must provide a safe stop-and-escalate path without software click-through instructions or patient examples.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
